title: Write landing copy to the research rules: a name, number or decision per sentence; limits after the proof; AI leads only in the hook
body:
Rules from the 2026-10-26 research, on top of CLAUDE.md's voice rules. The copy lives in src/lib/landing-copy.ts (ES first, EN translated).
- Every sentence carries a proper name, a number or a decision. No adjectives about the person.
- Open each proof chapter with who needed what, before the skill.
- Numbers only from the dataset through formatMetric/formatMetricEnds (the '~'), never typed in; a TODO never becomes a headline.
- State facts plainly, no humblebrag. Limits (Inglés A2) go plainly and only AFTER the proof; on /en/, near the contact path.
- AI is framed as owned verification ('lo que entra al repo lo decido yo'), never the headline, with ONE exception decided by the author 2026-10-29: the hero hook leads with it ('Trabajo con agentes de código todos los días, y construí DeltaDictum para darles lo que el código no dice.'). Do not 'fix' the hook back, and do not extend the exception to other chapters. CLAUDE.md records it.
- One line of text per beat inside pinned scenes; longer explanation goes to the free-scroll chapters.
- Same facts in both languages: /en/ direct, short and literal; / keeps the dataset's rioplatense voice.
- No 'hire me', no false scarcity, no skill bars, no logo wall, no testimonials or services slot while those collections are empty.
- One CV label everywhere: 'Descargar CV' / 'Download CV'.
not_derivable: These came from a deleted research report; CLAUDE.md carries only the general voice test, not the placement and AI-framing rules or why the hook is the exception.
